TEACHER EDUCATION PATHWAYS COURSE SYLLABUS
Education for personal renewal and social transformation.
A leading future-ready education university responsive to national and global development goals and directions Philippine Normal University is committed to lead innovative, responsive and sustainable teacher education programs that set the standards of future-ready teachers and education leaders. As the National Center for Teacher Education, the Philippine Normal University commits to provide inclusive, innovative, impactful, and sustainable teacher education programs that produce future-ready teachers and education leaders imbued with the values of truth, excellence, and service. Furthermore, PNU shall ensure the continual improvement of its Quality Management System through compliance with International Quality Standards and statutory and regulatory requirements. PNU shall achieve these commitments through its core functions of instruction, research, extension, and production. Digitally Literate and Data-Driven Decision Maker Design Thinker and Innovator Discerning and Compassionate Person Dynamic Lifelong Learner and Leader Deeply Rooted Global Citizen The College of Teacher Development (CTD) is committed to champion quality teacher education in the country. It is dedicated to:
1. Provide future-ready teacher development through innovative, inclusive and quality-assured academic programs.
2. Lead in advancing teacher education research and translating scholarly work into relevant policies and practices that benefit education and communities.
3. Establish CTD as leader in producing impactful educational resources, and programs. 4. Establish a robust international presence through strategic collaborations, advancing the College’s
leadership in teacher education. 5. Maintain a pool of faculty experts who lead as influential public intellectuals in education and related
disciplines.

Program Outcomes

Develop innovative curricula, instructional plans, and apply a wide range of teaching process skills and resources for diverse learners.

PPST 1.1.1 Demonstrate content knowledge and its application within and/or across curriculum teaching areas.

Course Number Course Title Course Pre-requisite Course Description

TP-S-TLE01 Introduction to Industrial Arts N/A This introductory course provides an overview of the concept of industrial arts. It includes discussions on technology, its evolution, utilization, and significance; with industry, its organization, materials, occupations, processes, and products; and problems and benefits resulting from the technological nature of society. As an introductory subject, students are expected to complete hands-on projects on competency-based applications and develop certain habits, attitudes, and abilities desirable for all citizens of an industrial and technological society.

UNIT III Key Components/ Sub-Areas of Industrial Arts

Essential Questions:

How do masonry, carpentry, and plumbing contribute to the safety, functionality, and aesthetics of our built environment?

In what ways do technical skills in industrial arts empower individuals to solve everyday problems?

PNU is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive academic environment for students from various backgrounds, including those with disabilities, exceptionalities, ethnic and linguistic differences, religious affiliations, gender identities, and other individual differences. The University ensures its commitment to equal access, participation, and engagement with educational opportunities that supports our academic culture and values as well as celebrate diversity and inclusivity.

If you have any physical or psychological/ mental health conditions or challenges which can affect your performance in class, you are encouraged to inform me. This is to ensure that we are creating and fostering a responsive classroom environment. You are also encouraged to avail of the services of the following offices regarding your challenge/ condition: - Student Affairs and Services Office: counselingservices@pnu.edu.ph - University Health Services Unit: uhsu@pnu.edu.ph - Gender, Equity, Diversity, and Inclusivity Office: gedio@pnu.edu.ph
